Operational_definition: The study did not report an extractable incident Alzheimer disease/dementia outcome for AMD versus non-AMD participants.
The article addressed genetic association, Mendelian randomization, or shared biology rather than an eligible clinical incident-risk estimate.
The exposure direction was dementia/treatment/nutrition/anti-VEGF rather than AMD status predicting incident AD/dementia.
The report was available only as an abstract or did not provide enough extractable data for quantitative synthesis.
The design assessed prevalent or cross-sectional AMD/cognition/AD status and could not establish incident risk.
The exposure was visual impairment, cataract, glaucoma, general eye disease, or another non-AMD-specific ophthalmic construct.
The article provided retinal/pathology/neuroimaging/biomarker evidence without an eligible longitudinal clinical outcome.
The design was case-control or otherwise did not provide the required incident cohort effect estimate.
The article was a review, editorial, comment, or other non-original research output.

Primary_exclusion_reason: Overlapping cohort; more complete included study available
Operational_definition: The study population overlapped with an included study that provided a more complete or more relevant estimate.
